title: Grade 5 French — Mon, Jun 09
description: La nourriture au marché — Day 1 of 5: Market vocabulary and quantities
subject: french

questions.question: What is 'le marché' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Le marché' = the market. 'Je vais au marché.' = I go to the market.

questions.question: How do you say 'a kilo of tomatoes' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Un kilo de tomates' = a kilo of tomatoes. 'De' links the quantity to the item.

questions.question: What does 'une bouteille de' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Une bouteille de...' = a bottle of... 'Une bouteille d'eau.' = A bottle of water.

questions.question: What does 'un paquet de' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Un paquet de...' = a packet/pack of... 'Un paquet de biscuits.' = A packet of biscuits.

questions.question: How do you say 'a litre of milk' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Un litre de lait' = a litre of milk. 'Litre' is a measurement of volume.

questions.question: What is 'la boulangerie' in English?
questions.explanation: 'La boulangerie' = the bakery. 'Je vais à la boulangerie pour acheter du pain.' = I go to the bakery to buy bread.

questions.question: What does 'une douzaine de' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Une douzaine de...' = a dozen (12) of... 'Une douzaine d'œufs.' = A dozen eggs.

questions.question: How do you ask for 500 grams of cheese in French?
options: Je voudrais un kilo de fromage.
Je voudrais cinq cents grammes de fromage.
Je voudrais une bouteille de fromage.
Je voudrais un litre de fromage.
questions.explanation: 'Je voudrais cinq cents grammes de fromage.' = I would like 500 grams of cheese.

questions.question: What is 'la charcuterie' in English?
questions.explanation: 'La charcuterie' = deli/cold meats shop. Sells ham, sausages, pâté.

questions.question: Complete: 'Je voudrais ___ kilo de pommes.' (I would like one kilo of apples.)
questions.explanation: 'Je voudrais un kilo de pommes.' = I would like a kilo of apples. 'Kilo' is masculine → 'un'.

questions.question: What does 'le poissonnier' sell?
questions.explanation: 'Le poissonnier' = the fishmonger. 'J'achète du poisson chez le poissonnier.' = I buy fish at the fishmonger's.

questions.question: How do you say 'a bunch of grapes' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Une grappe de raisins' = a bunch/cluster of grapes. 'Une grappe' is specifically used for grapes.

questions.question: Match: 'une boîte de conserve' = ?
questions.explanation: 'Une boîte de conserve' = a tin/can of food. 'Une boîte de thon' = a tin of tuna.

questions.question: What does 'l'épicerie' mean?
questions.explanation: 'L'épicerie' = the grocery store. 'Je fais mes courses à l'épicerie.' = I do my shopping at the grocery store.

questions.question: Complete the shopping list: '___ kilo de tomates, ___ litre de lait, ___ bouteille d'huile'
questions.explanation: Un kilo (masc.), un litre (masc.), une bouteille (fem.) — gender determines 'un' or 'une'.
